explanation: Decode the native UTF-8 strings into UTF-16 code units so returned positions match the published C# string-index contract. Build KMP prefix lengths for the pattern, then scan the text while reusing those prefixes after a mismatch. Return the first matching UTF-16 index, 0 for an empty pattern, or -1 when absent. The published RabinKarp method name is retained; the actual algorithm is KMP.
timeComplexity: O(n+m) worst-case time for input text and pattern lengths, including Unicode decoding and KMP search.
spaceComplexity: O(n+m) auxiliary space for decoded code-unit strings and the pattern prefix table.
attribution: Original EPI Practice C++ implementation, independently authored from the public EPI problem contract and the repository-authored C# algorithm. Uses unchanged local EPI Judge serialization and test framework APIs; upstream reference sources are not modified.
